fusions.name: Lowing Echo
fusions.desc: A low cry carries 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 7 resonating damage to everything in it, and 10% more for each ally near you, up to 30%. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Drinking From Giants
fusions.desc: A deep bite that deals 26 damage plus 5% of the maximum health of a boss or elite, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Herd Huddle
fusions.desc: Every ally within 4 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more power for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Stomach
fusions.desc: Whenever you are healed, you restore 6 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
